title: 學華語向前走 2B — Lesson 9
description: Vocabulary from lesson 9 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2B, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì zhǐnánzhēn.
exampleSentences.english: This is a compass.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhǐnánzhēn zhǐxiàng běifāng.
exampleSentences.english: The compass points north.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們去露營，帶了指南針。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù lùyíng, dài le zhǐnánzhēn.
exampleSentences.english: We went camping and took a compass.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhǐnánzhēn zài wǒ de shūbāo lǐ.
exampleSentences.english: My compass is in my school bag.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège zhǐběizhēn shì hóngsè de.
exampleSentences.english: This compass is red.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我看指北針，它指向北方。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn zhǐběizhēn, tā zhǐxiàng běifāng.
exampleSentences.english: I look at the compass, it points north.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de zhǐběizhēn zài nǎlǐ?
exampleSentences.english: Where is my compass?

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba sòng wǒ yí ge zhǐběizhēn.
exampleSentences.english: Dad gave me a compass.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì yì běn shū, tā hěn hǎokàn.
exampleSentences.english: This is a book, and it's very nice.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這枝筆很好用，它是藍色的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè zhī bǐ hěn hǎoyòng, tā shì lánsè de.
exampleSentences.english: This pen works well, and it's blue.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 桌子上有一個杯子，它是空的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge bēizi, tā shì kōng de.
exampleSentences.english: There's a cup on the table, and it's empty.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de qiú diào le, tā zài nǎlǐ?
exampleSentences.english: I dropped my ball, where is it?

exampleSentences.pinyin: Àozhōu zài Zhōngguó de nánfāng.
exampleSentences.english: Australia is in the south of China.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nánfāng hěn rè, běifāng hěn lěng.
exampleSentences.english: The south is hot, the north is cold.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de āyí zhù zài nánfāng.
exampleSentences.english: My aunt lives in the south.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù nánfāng de hǎibiān wán.
exampleSentences.english: We go to the beach in the south to play.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Běijīng zài běifāng.
exampleSentences.english: Beijing is in the north.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 北方在上面，南方在下面。
exampleSentences.pinyin: běifāng zài shàngmiàn, nánfāng zài xiàmiàn.
exampleSentences.english: The north is at the top, the south is at the bottom.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 冬天北方很冷，我穿毛衣。
exampleSentences.pinyin: dōngtiān běifāng hěn lěng, wǒ chuān máoyī.
exampleSentences.english: In winter it's very cold in the north, so I wear a jumper.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸說他想去北方看雪。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba shuō tā xiǎng qù běifāng kàn xuě.
exampleSentences.english: Dad says he wants to go north to see snow.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒmen de jiàoshì.
exampleSentences.english: This is our classroom.

exampleSentences.pinyin: jiàoshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō shū.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of books in the classroom.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàkè hòu, wǒmen zǒu chū jiàoshì.
exampleSentences.english: After class, we walk out of the classroom.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我星期六在教室學中文。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiàoshì xué zhōngwén.
exampleSentences.english: On Saturdays I learn Chinese in the classroom.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng nǐ gàosu wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: Please tell me.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老師告訴我們明天不上課。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī gàosu wǒmen míngtiān bú shàngkè.
exampleSentences.english: The teacher told us there's no class tomorrow.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我告訴媽媽，我的作業做完了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gàosu māma, wǒ de zuòyè zuòwán le.
exampleSentences.english: I told Mum my homework is finished.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 出門前要告訴爸爸你去哪裡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chūmén qián yào gàosu bàba nǐ qù nǎlǐ.
exampleSentences.english: Before you go out, tell Dad where you're going.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ kàn zhège fāngxiàng.
exampleSentences.english: Look in this direction.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xuéxiào zài nǎge fāngxiàng?
exampleSentences.english: Which direction is the school in?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 指南針可以幫我們找方向。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhǐnánzhēn kěyǐ bāng wǒmen zhǎo fāngxiàng.
exampleSentences.english: A compass can help us find our direction.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們迷路了，找不到方向。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen mílù le, zhǎobudào fāngxiàng.
exampleSentences.english: We're lost and can't work out which way to go.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zài xiàoménkǒu děng nǐ.
exampleSentences.english: I'll wait for you at the school entrance.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàoménkǒu yǒu yì kē dà shù.
exampleSentences.english: There's a big tree at the school entrance.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽每天在校門口接我。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma měitiān zài xiàoménkǒu jiē wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: Mum picks me up at the school entrance every day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 校門口有很多家長和小孩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàoménkǒu yǒu hěn duō jiāzhǎng hé xiǎohái.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of parents and kids at the school entrance.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì zúqiúchǎng.
exampleSentences.english: This is a soccer field.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zúqiúchǎng hěn dà.
exampleSentences.english: The soccer field is big.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 星期六我在足球場踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xīngqīliù wǒ zài zúqiúchǎng tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: On Saturday I play soccer on the field.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 足球場上有很多小朋友。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zúqiúchǎng shàng yǒu hěn duō xiǎopéngyou.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of kids on the soccer field.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tàiyáng cóng dōngfāng shēngqǐ.
exampleSentences.english: The sun rises in the east.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Rìběn zài Zhōngguó de dōngfāng.
exampleSentences.english: Japan is to the east of China.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 東方的天空很亮，太陽出來了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: dōngfāng de tiānkōng hěn liàng, tàiyáng chūlái le.
exampleSentences.english: The sky in the east is bright, the sun has come up.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ zhīdào dōngfāng zài nǎlǐ ma?
exampleSentences.english: Do you know where the east is?

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ yào chá háishi guǒzhī?
exampleSentences.english: Do you want tea or juice?

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ xǐhuan gǒu háishi māo?
exampleSentences.english: Do you like dogs or cats?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們明天去公園還是去海邊？
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen míngtiān qù gōngyuán háishi qù hǎibiān?
exampleSentences.english: Shall we go to the park or the beach tomorrow?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǎnfàn chī miàn háishi fàn?
exampleSentences.english: Noodles or rice for dinner?

exampleSentences.pinyin: tàiyáng cóng xīfāng luòxià.
exampleSentences.english: The sun sets in the west.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Ōuzhōu zài Zhōngguó de xīfāng.
exampleSentences.english: Europe is to the west of China.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我家在學校的西方，走路五分鐘。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ jiā zài xuéxiào de xīfāng, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.
exampleSentences.english: My house is west of the school, five minutes' walk.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 傍晚的西方很漂亮，有很多雲。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàngwǎn de xīfāng hěn piàoliang, yǒu hěn duō yún.
exampleSentences.english: The western sky at dusk is beautiful, with lots of clouds.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我很高興，因為今天是星期六。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn gāoxìng, yīnwèi jīntiān shì xīngqīliù.
exampleSentences.english: I'm happy because today is Saturday.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 因為下雨，我們不去公園。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen bú qù gōngyuán.
exampleSentences.english: Because it's raining, we're not going to the park.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我喜歡狗，因為牠很可愛。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan gǒu, yīnwèi tā hěn kě'ài.
exampleSentences.english: I like dogs because they're so cute.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yīnwèi tài rè, wǒmen qù yóuyǒng.
exampleSentences.english: Because it's too hot, we're going swimming.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 天氣很冷，所以我穿毛衣。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chuān máoyī.
exampleSentences.english: It's cold, so I wear a jumper.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn kě, suǒyǐ wǒ hē shuǐ.
exampleSentences.english: I'm thirsty, so I drink water.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的球壞了，所以我很傷心。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de qiú huài le, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn shāngxīn.
exampleSentences.english: My ball broke, so I'm sad.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽做了蛋糕，所以我們很開心。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma zuò le dàngāo, suǒyǐ wǒmen hěn kāixīn.
exampleSentences.english: Mum made a cake, so we're really happy.
